fusions.name: Lees
fusions.desc: Pulls a surge of water at the first enemy it meets that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each one used. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stockpot
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sends out a ring of broth that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 30%).

fusions.name: Toast All Round
fusions.desc: You restore 8 health, and every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Salt Thirst
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
